gates.threshold: F9 best reward-comparable cell mean test reward > Phase-6 DQN +1336 by ≥1σ (apples-to-apples; reward-coefficient cells fall back to security-KPI strand per D7.1.1)
gates.interpretation: FAIL-WITH-FINDING (D7.1.1, activated 2026-05-01): no reward-comparable cell (environment-design reward fn preserved) beats DQN +1336 on raw reward by ≥ 1σ. BUT: the security-KPI strand passes — cell `impact_is_terminal_false` improves mitigated_impact_rate to 0.867 (vs DQN baseline 0.153, ≥ 1.5× threshold 0.229). The one-at-a-time linear sweep characterised the limit of environment-design-style reward shaping at the apples-to-apples reward level, but env-semantics + coefficient scaling do move the real-security needle. Closing the +288 reward gap under fixed reward semantics requires a different mechanism (curriculum, reward modelling, or attack-aware exploration), deferred to future work.
